summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Famine/63)

data.turoyo: ŭ ánnaqqa u+qaləb̥ste g̥̊saymíwaynale, quršíwayna ... əmṭíwayna ánnaqqa qaṣmono dat+tanure: qáṭmoyo, qaṣmono? Gnuḥlíwaynale, g̊saymíwaynale ḥawdal, ŭ guršíwaynale ha hawxa, ʕal u+qalbawo.
data.translation: And then we would make a mold, we would cover… we would then bring soot from the oven: is it ashes, soot? We would sieve it, we would make it (like) grape pudding, and we would pull it out just like so, over that mold.

rationale: First I Infectum-wa example, with literal sifting of soot/ash in a craft process.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (58/39)

data.turoyo: Məlla: "Ya kurək! Hawli a sʕore diqanək, u tawno nḥilawo laǧani w haw u tawno fayiṭo, i kuzməke, lu səsyawo, lu səsyawo du faḥəl! Ono gədamṭyalluxyo."
data.translation: Die Stute sprach: "Junge! Gib mir die gestampfte Gerste und den gesiebten Häcksel und gib den faulen Häcksel, den Gerstenabfall jenem Pferd, dem Rassehengst! Dann werde ich es dir holen."

rationale: Fill Detransitive Part. Pass. 1 with an attributive demonstrative form nḥilawo.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (58/88)

data.turoyo: Hawli a sʕore diqe w tawno u nḥilo, u naḏ̣ifo! W hat i kuzməke w u tawno fayiṭo lu səsyo w tux ʕal aloho w aʕli!"
data.translation: Gib mir die gestampfte Gerste und den gesiebten, sauberen Häcksel, und gib den Abfall und den faulen Häcksel dem Hengst, und dann komm, vertraue auf Gott und mich!"

rationale: Fill the thin Part. Pass. 1 cell with coordinated nḥilo and clean feed in a complete instruction.

summary: Add I 2 as a figurative use supported by the Turoyo noḥəl ax xabre and the following question about words of killing. This is one court episode and must not be generalized into an independently established technical legal term.

MAC NE Famine/63 introduces Infectum-wa with a first-person plural actor and suffixed material object. Preserve the edition's hesitation between soot and ashes; do not choose one substance on its behalf.
nḥilo/nḥilawo is an attributive Detransitive Part. Pass. modifying tawno. The repeated horse-feed passages show the same resultant material quality; no new Detransitive sense is required.

58/36 and 94/254 are already the inherited quotations. The latter supplied German says sieht where sifting is intended, but the existing glossary wording siebt is sensible; do not rewrite the entry or add a duplicate defective translation.
Is figurative noḥəl ax xabre conventional outside this court episode, or a speaker's productive metaphor? Only the attested usage, not a technical legal register, is proposed.
At 94/254 the supplied edition text has sieht where the existing entry has siebt; verify the source transcription before any correction.
